title: French Lick Springs Hotel

terrainReference.basis: Original ground on the lawn immediately east of the porch approach.

identities.name: French Lick Springs Hotel
identities.address: 8670 West State Road 56, French Lick, Indiana

mapIdentity.scope: The 44-point named hotel footprint contains the linked elongated front, North Wing, West Wing, oblique Deluxe Wing and two-storey Spa Wing.

note: The exact Qualla original supports the southeast profile, door and sash rhythms, veranda and yellow masonry. The National Register description distinguishes the other sections, many of which have flat roofs and limestone parapets. Original terrain fixes the lawn and hillside context.
